name: Hakmoni
title: Father of David's counselor
summary: Hakmoni is a biblical figure mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He is known as the father of Jashobeam, one of David's mighty warriors among the thirty heroes. Hakmoni lived during the time of the united kingdom of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Hakmoni's son among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam, son of Hakmoni, is mentioned as the leader of David's thirty heroes and one of the three most powerful warriors.

keyEvents.title: Jashobeam as commander of the first division
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam, son of the Hakmonite, served as commander of the first military division in the first month during David's organization of the army.

keyEvents.title: Jashobeam's heroic deed
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam, son of Hakmoni, killed three hundred men in one battle and became known as the foremost among David's heroes.

keyEvents.title: The Hakmonite Jehiel as counselor
keyEvents.description: Jehiel, the Hakmonite, is mentioned as one appointed to care for the king's sons, linking the Hakmoni family to David's court.
